summary:
Iteration 3 verification (frontend-only). All 6 requested checks PASSED on the Expo web preview (375x667). REGRESSIONS: (1) Home quick-action labels Income/Expense/Transfer/Reports render single-line, no broken chars — VERIFIED. (2) FAB positioned at (x=295, y=519, 56x56) => bottom edge 575px, ~92px above tab bar — VERIFIED. (3) Wallet card tap navigates to /wallet/[id] with prefilled Name='Main Bank', Type=Bank, Balance='3200' — VERIFIED. (4) Update flow: $3,200 -> $5,000 via Save changes, Wallets list total updates from $3,450 -> $5,250 with Main Bank $5,000.00 — VERIFIED. NEW FIXES: (A) Trash icon on /wallet/[id] now fires window.confirm on web with message 'Delete wallet?

This also deletes all transactions in this wallet.'; accepting deletes wallet via DELETE /api/wallets/{id} and navigates back to Wallets list where Main Bank is gone — VERIFIED. (B) Long-press on wallet card fires window.confirm with 'Delete wallet

Delete "Cash" and its transactions?'; accepting deletes and EmptyState 'No wallets yet' renders — VERIFIED. (C) Clearing Balance and pressing Save shows inline error 'Enter a balance (use 0 for empty)' and does NOT overwrite balance to 0 (subsequent 3200->5000 update succeeded, proving no zero-overwrite occurred) — VERIFIED. Backend retest skipped per request (iteration 2 was 34/34).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings still emitted on load: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking, carried over from iteration 2. References: multiple UI components.

action_items: (Optional, carried over) Migrate shadow* styles to boxShadow and pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents to silence RN 0.76+ deprecation warnings.

(Optional) Consider replacing native Alert.alert branch in /app/frontend/src/utils/confirm.ts eventually with a custom Modal for full cross-platform parity, but current Platform.OS split (window.confirm on web, Alert.alert on native) satisfies the bug fix cleanly.
critical_code_review_comments: confirm.ts is compact and correct: Platform.OS branch on 'web' uses window.confirm, else Alert.alert. onConfirm return value is wrapped in Promise.resolve for async support. Good.
wallet/[id].tsx submit() correctly guards on balance.trim()==='' BEFORE parseFloat, so empty input no longer silently zeroes the wallet. Number.isNaN(parseFloat) is also guarded. Good.
wallets.tsx confirmDelete extracted as module-level helper is fine. Consider passing reload/router via closure or context if reused elsewhere.
Edit wallet screen still fetches full wallets list to find one by id — minor: prefer GET /api/wallets/{id} once available.

success_rate.backend: N/A (skipped per request; last verified 34/34 in iteration 2)

seed_data_creation: Fresh signup naka+<epoch>@matrix.dev with auto-seeded Cash $250 + Main Bank $3,200. Both wallets consumed by the delete tests, leaving user in EmptyState.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wallet CRUD (create implicit via seed, read, update, delete) fully working on web preview via cross-platform confirm helper /app/frontend/src/utils/confirm.ts. All original regressions (single-line quick-action labels, FAB position bottom:24, tap-to-edit CRUD) still holding. Screenshots at /tmp/z04_guard.png (balance guard error), /tmp/z05_saved.png ($5,000 after save), /tmp/z06_after_delete.png (Main Bank gone), /tmp/z07_longpress.png (empty state after long-press delete).
rca_of_issue: N/A — all issues from iteration 2 are resolved. The delete-confirm no-op on web was fixed by introducing confirmAction() which routes to window.confirm on Platform.OS==='web' and Alert.alert on native. The silent balance-to-0 bug was fixed by adding an explicit `if (balance.trim() === '')` guard before parseFloat in submit().
